title: The Telangana Advocates Clerks Welfare Fund Act, 1992.
full_text: The Telangana Advocates Clerks Welfare Fund Act, 1992. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act Number: 13 Enactment Date: 1992-04-15 Act Year: 1992 Short Title: The Telangana Advocates Clerks Welfare Fund Act, 1992. Long Title: An Act to provide for the Constitution of a Welfare Fund for the benefit of Advocates Clerks in the State of Telangana and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
